title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 13: brotherly love and hospitality, contentment, going outside the camp, and the closing words of the letter.

questions.text: What have some done without knowing it, by showing hospitality to strangers?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so some have entertained angels without knowing it.

answers.text: Fed their own enemies
Housed travelling teachers
Entertained angels
Welcomed kings into their homes

questions.text: Whom does verse 3 tell them to remember?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says to remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated.

answers.text: Those in bonds and those who are ill-treated
Those who have gathered great riches
The priests who serve the tabernacle
Those who live in distant cities

questions.text: What does verse 4 say about marriage and the bed?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled.

answers.text: Marriage is only for the leaders of the people
Marriage is to be held in honor and the bed undefiled
The bed of marriage is to be left empty
Marriage is to be kept away from strangers

questions.text: Which words are quoted in verse 5 as the reason to be content?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says to be free from the love of money and content with what you have, for he has said, "I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you."

answers.text: I will give you a land of your own
I will repay all that you have lost
I will bless you and multiply you
I will in no way leave you, neither forsake you

questions.text: What do they say with good courage, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that with good courage we say, "The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?"

answers.text: The Lord is a consuming fire
The Lord will judge his own people
The Lord is my helper; I will not fear
The Lord swore and will not change his mind

questions.text: What does verse 8 say about Jesus Christ?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

answers.text: He will appear a second time soon
He is the same yesterday, today, and forever
He will shake the heavens again
He changes with the times

questions.text: By what is it good that the heart be established, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, and warns against being carried away by various and strange teachings.

answers.text: By grace
By food
By strange teachings
By the law

questions.text: Where did Jesus suffer, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says that Jesus suffered outside of the gate, so that he might sanctify the people through his own blood.

answers.text: In the holy place
On the mountain
At the altar
Outside of the gate

questions.text: Which sacrifice does the writer call them to offer up continually?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says: through him let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

answers.text: A sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips
A sacrifice of bulls and goats
A tenth of all of their goods
A burnt offering at the gate

questions.text: Which brother is said to have been freed?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says: know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

answers.text: Barnabas
Silas
Timothy
Mark
